what: Verified AI SaaS revenue leaderboard: Postiz at $479k MRR (14k subs), Rezi $230k, AEO Engine $193k, Cometly $191k, AiSDR $172k as of Nov 27 2026. Median ~$70k among $50k+ tier. Data from TrustMRR payment verification.
why_us: Concrete proof of what AI SaaS categories scale (social scheduling agents, resume tools, ad attribution, sales SDR). Shows high ARPU B2B models work.
engagement: Live updated leaderboard, thousands of data points

what: Gamma.app (AI presentation tool) has terrible Trustpilot ratings (~1.6/5 from 125+ reviews). Users complain AI doesn't follow instructions, presentations overflow, all look the same, $12-90/mo too expensive, locks access after cancel, recommends Canva instead. Multiple 1-star 'waste of money' reviews.
why_us: Clear pain in AI presentation tools: unreliable generation, poor control, high price for low quality. Opportunity for better controllable, template-aware, or outcome-focused alternative.
engagement: 125+ reviews, majority negative on quality and price

what: ElevenLabs voice generation widely complained as too expensive on G2 (171+ mentions of high cost for multiple datasets/fine-tuning). Users want cheaper bulk generation and better voice options/testing.
why_us: High willingness to pay for quality TTS but price sensitivity for volume. Gap for cheaper high-quality voice AI or better pricing tiers.

what: AI wrappers with verified revenue: Chatbase ~$864k MRR historically, Draft AI ~$24.5k, Sleek ~$23k, Backlinker AI ~$22.5k, fastwrite.io ~$15k, Taja AI ~$15k, MagicSlides ~$12k. Median AI wrapper earner ~$190 MRR across 1350+ products.
why_us: Shows thin wrappers can make real money when they add workflow/outcome, especially B2B high ARPU. Data from TrustMRR and public reports.

what: Subscription fatigue: Capterra survey shows 44% of consumers tired of subscriptions, 42% canceled in last 90 days mainly because too expensive or not worth the cost. 38% would cancel if price increases.
why_us: Broad pain around SaaS pricing and value. Supports micro-SaaS with clear ROI, one-time, or usage-based models.
engagement: Survey of consumers, high cancellation rates

what: X post: 'Chat-to-app, no subscription — that's the part I'd pay for.' Indicates demand for one-time or pay-per-use app builders instead of subscription AI tools.
why_us: Direct willingness to pay for non-subscription AI app generation. Aligns with subscription fatigue.

what: Searchable (AI search visibility / AEO platform) hit $6M ARR in 10 months (Jan-Nov 2026). Helps brands control what AI systems say about them.
why_us: Rapid growth in AI visibility category. Shows demand for tools that manage brand presence in AI answers.
